title: Research exact budget floors for κ > 0.1
body:
## Result and scope

This adds two exact, source-bound budget screens for the user-set target κ > 0.1. Under the retained conversion κ=a/(1+a), the target requires a=1/9. With the current one-unpaid-coordinate coverage laws and rank caps, even the optimistic all-mass-at-cap floor is above one after deleting the centre charge: 1.005219793354 on bit (R=53) and 1.026397274382 on complex (R=51). Thus the current coverage/rank-cap models cannot reach κ=0.1. This does not rule out a changed coverage law, different depth, or another architecture.

The complex follow-up screens the strongest already explored anchor bundle. Seven hypothetical anchors, centre removal, and fractional rank-16 repacking still need ten unpaid coordinates per family (u=9 fails, u=10 passes); retaining the centre needs eleven. The unchanged selected complex profile remains above one even at its largest feasible centre-free unpaid count, and the pinned five-plane profile's paid terms alone exceed one at a=1/9.

These are necessary-budget screens only. No replacement endpoint, supplier, new κ, or selected-frontier change is claimed. The exact thresholds and remaining obligations are in [the joint bit/complex rank-cap result](research/kappa010-rank-cap-floor/README.md) and [the complex lever result](research/kappa010-complex-lever-floor/README.md).

## Validation

On CPython 3.12, both registered package runs passed:

- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/kappa010-rank-cap-floor`
- `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/kappa010-complex-lever-floor`

Both publication-byte checks passed with `scripts/check_research_commit.py`; metadata/source pins and `git diff --check` also passed. The verifiers use exact rational comparisons and outward-rational intervals, with adjacent fail/pass boundary checks.

## Next work

The smallest useful follow-up is a complete dirty-input endpoint that carries at least two unpaid coordinates on bit and four on complex at the current caps, or a source-bound depth-six row invoice that admits the required higher ranks. The complex anchor/rank-16 route needs ten unpaid coordinates with centre removal and a priced rank-16 consumer. Both package READMEs state concrete first steps and blockers.

This refines the `coverage-law-change` task from the repository's planning target κ > 0.01 to the donor-set target κ > 0.1. The task began on d8e0f83 and was rechecked against canonical main 18aacb215; priority revision 6 and the selected record are unchanged. Credit and predecessor lineage are preserved in each package. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
